title: Magnetic Screen Door, Sunflower Print Mesh Curtain With Lace Edge, Hands-Free Self-Closing Insect Mosquito Net, Keep Bugs Out Pet Friendly, Fits Single Door For Home Patio Kitchen Doorway
body_html:
【Strong Magnet】: Features powerful magnetic blocks for automatic closing, ensuring secure and easy operation.

【Sunflower Print】: Adorned with a sunflower print and lace edge, adding a decorative touch to any home.

【Pet Friendly】: Designed for pet-friendly access, allowing free movement without obstruction.

【Ventilation】: Provides effective ventilation while keeping bugs out, perfect for outdoor spaces.

【Easy Storage】: Includes a storage strap for convenient bundling and easy storage when not in use.
